summary: Wrote a 4-phase plan implementing the research-selected remedy: widen the aggregator's filter (.resolution // "open") plus an additive implicit_open_count tally, with both issue-log.md and conclusion-stage.md updated to state what a null resolution means. Set file_scope to six source-store paths under agent-system/extensions/core/**. Found and planned around a real trap: the aggregator's own test suite resolves the deployed script copy first, so it must not be run until after deploy. The mandated BimodalLogic 739/740 regression fixture is exercised through an isolated scratch root (no cross-repo deploy), with expected figures derived from all 18 live fixture entries.

artifacts.summary: 4-phase plan: widen the conclusion-stage filter to read null resolution as open, add an informational implicit_open_count tally, document null's meaning in both contracts, cover the null case in the aggregator's regression suite, then deploy and prove the fix on the real 739/740 fixture.
